scenes.title: Judge review path
scenes.voiceover: The review pack puts the recorded workflow, public evidence, source, release, and independent verification in one place. Next, open the accepted settlement in the live proof ledger.

scenes.title: Inspect the proof
scenes.voiceover: The proof view recomputes the offer hash, settlement hash, Ed25519 attestations, and linkage. The witness view exposes the recorded validator observation. Raw shows the portable signed bundle itself.

scenes.title: Verify outside the site
scenes.voiceover: Now run the copied command outside the website. It downloads the Cloudflare proof, ignores the hosted verdict, and independently checks fourteen ledger and cryptographic conditions. The verifier exits zero.

scenes.title: Evidence before trust
scenes.voiceover: This demo is a real browser and terminal recording. The signed payment evidence is localnet and labeled as such. Public-network receipts still require two distinct HTTPS RPC witnesses.
